create_heuristic_perception_agent: create a HeuristicPerception instance that tracks bots in the agent world
run_perceive_bots: run the perceive method to scan the world and update bot memory nodes
create_player_node_for_bot: create a PlayerNode in memory for a newly perceived bot entity
tag_bot_memory_nodes: tag bot memory nodes with the bot tag using TripleNode
forget_removed_bots: forget bot memory entries for bots that are no longer in the world
